text.p: SurVivaLink Corp said Tuesday it completed a $11.2 million private placement of series A preferred stock.

The placement was led by Fidelity Ventures Ltd and Fidelity Investors LP, SurVivaLink said. Other institutional investors included CIBC Wood Gundy Ventures, the Spray Venture Fund LP, Wellmark Inc and Minnesota Management Partners I Ltd.

"We are very pleased to have attracted strong institutional support for our company," said Mark Wagner, president and chief executive. "The proceeds from this private placement will enable us to move forward with our strategic plans, including aggressive global marketing, supporting our leadership position in the early defibrillation market."
SurVivaLink designs and makes external defibrillators used to treat victims of sudden cardiac arrest.
